display_long_description:
# 1 - 3 Players. One spaceship. Survive the galaxy.
**EARLY ACCESS FOR QUEST 3 & 3S**

Find your crew on Discord👇

**https://www.sol-protocol.com/discord**

**GATHER YOUR TEAM**

On board, you have to adapt to the dynamically changing conditions. Want to navigate through an asteroid field? Become a Pilot. Ever dreamt of shooting down foes with your turrets? Gunner is perfect. Or would you rather strategically plan your next move and manage ship’s shielding system? Welcome Captain. Each role has a distinct set of tasks to perform and handy tools to utilize throughout the journey. 
[media]

**PLAN YOUR BATTLES**

Enemy spaceships are roaming the deep space, looking to destroy and loot your ship. Use different weapons and strategies to deal with intense randomized encounters and collect your loot afterward. Choose your battles wisely, warping away is sometimes the only way to avoid total annihilation.
[media]
**GATHER YOUR RESOURCES**

Resources are sparse, but vital both for the maintenance of your ship as well as future upgrades. Explore the deepest corners of the cosmos to find abandoned space stations and lost vessels to gather the necessary materials. Be careful, though - enemies are searching for loot too…
[media]

**MAINTAIN YOUR SHIP**

Keeping the ship aloft in space is a ceaseless but very rewarding task for the whole crew. Manually repair damaged components by replacing them with parts you find in the world or on deck. Carefully survey any damage  and use repair spheres to send nanobots outside to the affected parts. 
[media]
